name: Barbarian audit: Headhunting spell modifier reaches its target spells (#1846)
contract: Audit report #1846 asked for a script for a passive whose effects are native spell-mod auras (107 flat, 108 percent). The effect BasePoints and EffectSpellClassMask in Spell.dbc name the spell-mod operation, amount and affected Barbarian spells; Player::ApplySpellMod, which the spell_modifier metric calls, must deliver base+flat or base*(100+pct)/100. Expected values are computed from the DBC amount, not from the implementation.

500060 op 10 percent -20 reaches 804137 (mask selects 1 Barbarian spell(s))
